about.zh: 两个分数；期望是 Softmax 给出的两个权重
about.en: two scores; the two weights produced by Softmax expected

about.zh: 暗底上的亮块（有一点噪声）；期望是周围 7×7 全亮的格子
about.en: bright blocks on a dark ground with a little noise; the cells whose whole 7×7 is bright expected

about.zh: 一个矩形：x0, y0, 宽, 高
about.en: a rectangle: x0, y0, width, height

about.zh: 亮块上缺的格子
about.en: cells missing from the blocks

about.zh: 两个框的掩膜；期望是交并比（iou），或交并比是否大于 0.5（good）
about.en: two boxes’ masks; their intersection over union (iou), or whether it is over 0.5 (good), expected

about.zh: 一个框：x0, y0, x1, y1（不含 x1、y1）
about.en: a box: x0, y0, x1, y1 (x1, y1 excluded)

about.zh: 一个框：x0, y0, x1, y1（不含 x1、y1）
about.en: a box: x0, y0, x1, y1 (x1, y1 excluded)

about.zh: 关键点的窗口和三个候选：真搭档是同一块纹理调亮了 0.3，另两个是同样亮的平淡纹理；期望是搭档的编号
about.en: a keypoint’s window and three candidates, its partner the same texture brightened by 0.3, the others flat textures as bright; the partner’s number expected

about.zh: 几个图案，各有各的亮度；期望是每个图块都变成最亮的那个图案
about.en: a few patterns, each at its own brightness; every patch turned into the brightest pattern expected

about.zh: 第几行、第几列的图块
about.en: the row and column of its patch

about.zh: 一张有几个平滑鼓包的响应图；期望是它的峰：比 3×3 邻居都不小、又大于 above 的格子
about.en: a response map with smooth bumps; its peaks expected: cells no smaller than their 3×3 neighbours and above `above`

about.zh: 鼓包：cx, cy, 高
about.en: bumps: cx, cy, height

about.zh: 显微镜下的细胞：亮的细胞、暗一些的底、颗粒，挨着的细胞之间留一格缝；期望是细胞的掩膜
about.en: cells under a microscope, bright on a darker ground, with grain and one-pixel gaps between touching cells; the cells’ mask expected

about.zh: 细胞：x0, y0, x1, y1（不含 x1、y1）
about.en: a cell: x0, y0, x1, y1 (x1, y1 excluded)

about.zh: 竖缝所在的列
about.en: the columns of upright gaps

about.zh: 横缝所在的行
about.en: the rows of gaps across

about.zh: 一条街、ViT 类别 token 的查询和车所在的图块；期望是注意力落在车上的比例
about.en: a street, a ViT class token’s query and the patches with the car; the share of attention on the car expected

about.zh: 车的左边在第几列
about.en: the column of the car’s left side

about.zh: 房子的左边在第几列
about.en: the column of the house’s left side

about.zh: 车所在的图块 [列, 行]
about.en: the patches with the car, [column, row]

about.zh: 一条有车的街和一个线性分类器的权重（可以另给车的掩膜）；期望是每格的贡献、遮挡图、落在车上的分数比例、热图落在车上的比例，或体检的热图和判定
about.en: a street with a car and a linear classifier’s weights (and the car’s mask, maybe); each cell’s contribution, the occlusion map, the share of the score on the car, the share of the heat map on it, or the check-up’s heat map and verdict, expected

about.zh: 遮挡用的块：亮度 v，r × r（默认黑的 3 × 3）
about.en: the block covering: brightness v, r × r (black 3 × 3 at first)

about.zh: 车的左边在第几列
about.en: the column of the car’s left side

about.zh: 房子的左边在第几列
about.en: the column of the house’s left side

about.zh: 一条线和随机的杂点；期望是那条真线
about.en: a line among random specks; the true line expected

about.zh: 一条线经过的两点：x1, y1, x2, y2
about.en: two points on a line: x1, y1, x2, y2

about.zh: 一张彩色图的三个通道（各减 0.5）；期望是一种颜色对比（红对绿，或蓝对黄）的边
about.en: a colour picture’s three channels (each less 0.5); the edges of one colour contrast (red against green, or blue against yellow) expected

about.zh: 彩色噪点的种子
about.en: the seed of colour noise

about.zh: 一张彩色图；期望是模糊后的两种通道组合：R − G 和 R + G − 2B
about.en: a colour picture; two mixes of its blurred channels expected: R − G and R + G − 2B

about.zh: 书的照片、封面和匹配的点对（有噪声，夹着错配）；期望是用对的点对解出的单应贴回封面
about.en: a photo of the book, the cover and matched pairs (noisy, with wrong ones among them); the cover pasted back by the homography of the right pairs expected

about.zh: 书的四个角在照片里的位置
about.en: where the book’s four corners are in the photo

about.zh: 错配几对
about.en: how many wrong pairs

about.zh: 一张视差图（远墙视差 1）；期望是距离 f·b ÷ 视差。给了 f、b 时它们也是输入，否则 f·b = 3
about.en: a disparity map (the far wall at 1); the distance f·b ÷ disparity expected, f and b inputs too when given, else f·b = 3

about.zh: 它占的矩形：x0, y0, x1, y1（不含 x1、y1）
about.en: the rectangle it fills: x0, y0, x1, y1 (x1, y1 excluded)

about.zh: 远墙前面的几层，从后往前
about.en: the layers before the far wall, back to front

about.zh: 每格一个关键点，三张图是它到三个候选的距离；期望是距离比检验配上的候选（1–3，没配上是 0）
about.en: each cell a keypoint, three maps its distances to three candidates; the candidate the ratio test accepts (1–3, else 0) expected

about.zh: 第二近紧跟在后的格子
about.en: the cells where the second nearest is close behind

about.zh: 几只狗，每只是一团亮的斑；期望是每只狗的中心
about.en: a few dogs, each a solid bright blob; each dog’s centre expected

about.zh: 两张照片；期望是它们是不是同一张（挪了、调了色或加了噪声也算）
about.en: two photos; whether they are the same one (even shifted, recoloured or noisy) expected

about.zh: 一对相机的基础矩阵 F（按列）和左图的点 (x, y)；期望是右图里的极线 F·p
about.en: a camera pair’s fundamental matrix F (by columns) and a left point (x, y); the epipolar line F·p in the right image expected

about.zh: 同样的 F 的三列（按给的顺序）和 (0, 0, 1)；期望是极点 e′
about.en: the same F’s three columns (in the order given) and (0, 0, 1); the epipole e′ expected

about.zh: 蒙着细颗粒的照片（32 × 32，低于 10 周的成分都去掉的噪声）；期望是照片轻轻模糊（σ = 1，复制边缘）
about.en: a photo under fine grain (32 × 32, noise with everything below 10 cycles removed); the photo gently blurred (σ = 1, the edge replicated) is expected

about.zh: 闯入者：现场比空场多一个 4×4 的东西，光照不均；期望是它的掩膜
about.en: an intruder: the scene has one 4×4 thing more than the empty scene, lit unevenly; its mask is expected

about.zh: 一张图和一个分界 m；期望是 k 均值的一步给出的新分界（step），或走三步后按分界分出的掩膜（segment）
about.en: a picture and a boundary m; the new boundary one step of k-means gives (step), or the mask split at the boundary after three steps (segment), expected

about.zh: 噪声 ε（两个数）；期望是潜码 μ + σ·ε 画出的斑点。given：μ 和 σ 也是输入
about.en: noise ε (two numbers); the blob the latent code μ + σ·ε draws expected (given: μ and σ are inputs too)

about.zh: 潜空间里的两个数
about.en: two numbers in latent space

about.zh: 潜空间里的两个数
about.en: two numbers in latent space

about.zh: 潜空间里的两个数
about.en: two numbers in latent space

about.zh: 16 × 16 的货架上的小记号：X 是要找的盒子，O 不要；期望是每个 X 的中心
about.en: small marks on a 16 × 16 shelf, X for the boxes to find and O for the rest; each X’s centre expected

about.zh: 2 是大号
about.en: 2 for a large one

about.zh: 一张图上几个图案，一对对角上的同一个图案被擦掉了几格；期望是补好的图
about.en: a few patterns on a picture, a pair across the diagonal the same, one copy with a few pixels erased; the picture mended expected

about.zh: 图案的一格画成几格（2：8 × 8 的图案）
about.en: how many cells a pattern pixel takes (2: 8 × 8 patterns)

about.zh: 第几行、第几列的图块
about.en: the row and column of its patch

about.zh: 擦掉的格子 [u, v]
about.en: the pixels erased, [u, v]

about.zh: 两张这样的图，孪生图案的位置各不相同；期望是补好的两张图
about.en: two such pictures, their twins placed differently; both mended expected

about.zh: 第几行、第几列的图块
about.en: the row and column of its patch

about.zh: 擦掉的格子 [u, v]
about.en: the pixels erased, [u, v]

about.zh: 第几行、第几列的图块
about.en: the row and column of its patch

about.zh: 擦掉的格子 [u, v]
about.en: the pixels erased, [u, v]

about.zh: 两块布（日光下一样）和一盏灯；期望是相机读出的两块布 R、G、B 之差
about.en: two cloths that match in daylight, and a lamp; what the camera reads of their R, G and B differences is expected

about.zh: 十个波段（400–700 nm，每段 30 nm）的强度
about.en: the strength in ten bands (400–700 nm, 30 nm each)

about.zh: 十个波段（400–700 nm，每段 30 nm）的强度
about.en: the strength in ten bands (400–700 nm, 30 nm each)

about.zh: 几个亮点，从原位挪开一点；期望是原位的点做 2×2 最大池化
about.en: a few bright dots, moved a little from home; the 2×2 max pool of the dots at home expected

about.zh: 要找的照片和三张候选，其中一张是同一张照片（挪了、调了色或加了噪声）；期望是它那一路为 1
about.en: a photo to find and three candidates, one of them the same photo shifted, recoloured or noisy; 1 on its line expected

about.zh: 一个字母 x₀、一张高斯噪声 ε 和剩下多少 ᾱ；期望是一步加到的 x_t = √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε
about.en: a letter x₀, Gaussian noise ε and how much is left, ᾱ; x_t = √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε, noised in one step, expected

about.zh: 噪声的种子
about.en: the noise’s seed

about.zh: 带噪声的斑点；期望是干净的斑点
about.en: a noisy blob; the clean blob expected

about.zh: 斑点的中心 (x, y)
about.en: the blob’s centre (x, y)

about.zh: 带噪声的台阶（左暗右亮）：期望是真正的台阶处为 1
about.en: a noisy step, dark on the left and bright on the right: 1 where the real step is, expected

about.zh: 一排锚框 (cx, cy, w, h) 和网络给的修正 (tx, ty, tw, th)；期望是修正后的框
about.en: a row of anchor boxes (cx, cy, w, h) and the network’s corrections (tx, ty, tw, th); the corrected boxes expected

about.zh: 一张旧照片：一个字母在 ᾱ 下加了噪，噪声不知道；期望是还原的照片和字的笔画
about.en: an old photo, a letter noised at ᾱ with the noise unknown; the restored photo and the letter’s strokes expected

about.zh: 同样的 F、左图的点和右图的点 q；期望是 q 在不在极线上（|q·l′| < 0.05）
about.en: the same F, a left point and a right point q; whether q is on the epipolar line (|q·l′| < 0.05) expected

about.zh: 右图的点 (x′, y′)
about.en: the right point (x′, y′)

about.zh: 灰底上一块亮、一块暗，另给每格的图块编号；按阅读顺序亮块在前就整张图是 1
about.en: one bright and one dark patch on grey, with each cell’s patch number given; 1 all over when the bright one comes first in reading order

about.zh: 一个小格：期望是梯度幅值按方向（→ ↑ ← ↓）分到四个数，各除以格数
about.en: one cell: its gradient magnitude shared out to four directions (→ ↑ ← ↓), each divided by the cells, expected

about.zh: 闯入者的外圈：任意形状的闯入者站在花砖地面上；期望是它挨着地面的那一圈格子（图外算地面）
about.en: an intruder’s outer ring: an intruder of any shape on a tiled floor; the ring of its cells touching the floor is expected (outside the picture counts as floor)

about.zh: 一个矩形：x0, y0, 宽, 高
about.en: a rectangle: x0, y0, width, height

about.zh: 闯入者：几个矩形的并
about.en: the intruder: a union of rectangles

about.zh: 书的照片、清楚的封面和单应 H；期望是封面贴回照片上
about.en: a photo of the book, the crisp cover and the homography H; the cover pasted back onto the photo expected

about.zh: 书的四个角在照片里的位置
about.en: where the book’s four corners are in the photo

about.zh: 光度立体：一张有污渍的金属板，三盏已知方向的灯各拍一张；期望是它朝右倾的地方、它的反射率，或它陡的地方
about.en: photometric stereo: a stained metal sheet photographed under three lamps of known direction; where it leans right, its reflectance, or where it is steep, is expected

about.zh: 倾斜的门槛（lean：nx / nz；steep：坡度）
about.en: the threshold of the tilt (lean: nx / nz; steep: the slope)

about.zh: 鼓包：cx, cy, 半径, 高
about.en: a bump: cx, cy, radius, height

about.zh: 坑：cx, cy, 半径, 深
about.en: a dent: cx, cy, radius, depth

about.zh: 横梁：y0, 半宽, 高
about.en: a ridge: y0, half width, height

about.zh: 斜面：x 方向和 y 方向的坡度
about.en: a slope: its gradient across and down

about.zh: 沟：x0, y0, x1, y1, 半宽, 深
about.en: a groove: x0, y0, x1, y1, half width, depth
a saddle bend: k·((x − 7.5)² − (y − 7.5)²)

about.zh: 高度场：几项相加（每项一个键），空表是平板
about.en: a height field: terms added up (one key each); none is a flat sheet

about.zh: 污渍的种子
about.en: the stains’ seed

about.zh: 一张 16 × 16 的图和它 2 × 2 最大池化后的 8 × 8；期望是反池化：每个值放回它原来的那一格，其余为 0
about.en: a 16 × 16 picture and its 8 × 8 after 2 × 2 max pooling; the unpooling expected: each value back in its own cell, the rest 0

about.zh: 按分数排好的检测对错、名次 1 … 16 和标注数 G；期望是 AP
about.en: the detections right or wrong in score order, the ranks 1 … 16 and the number labelled G; the AP expected

about.zh: 按分数排好的 16 个检测，对 1 错 0
about.en: the 16 detections in score order, right 1 and wrong 0

about.zh: 一个彩色场景（R、G、B 三张图），光照不均；期望是红色东西的掩膜（R 占三者之和一半以上）
about.en: a coloured scene (R, G, B), lit unevenly; the mask of what is red (R over half of the three’s sum) is expected

about.zh: 同一个物体换了灯光：亮度 × gain + offset；期望是它的边（梯度大于最大值一半的地方）
about.en: one object under other light, brightness × gain + offset; its edges (where the gradient is over half its maximum) are expected

about.zh: 加了噪的 x_t、当初加的噪声 ε 和 ᾱ；期望是原来的字母 x₀
about.en: the noisy x_t, the noise ε that was added and ᾱ; the letter x₀ as it was expected

about.zh: 彩色图像；期望是一种颜色对比的边
about.en: a colour image; edges of a colour contrast are expected

about.zh: 彩色噪点的种子
about.en: the seed of colour noise

about.zh: 彩色图像；期望是两种模糊通道组合
about.en: a colour image; two mixes of blurred channels are expected

about.zh: 彩色街景；期望是红灯的掩膜
about.en: a colour street scene; the red lights’ mask is expected

about.zh: 暗路面上的车道线和几个亮斑；期望是投票累加器（× 1/8）里的峰
about.en: lanes on a dark road with a few bright specks; the peaks of the vote accumulator (× 1/8) expected

about.zh: 一条线经过的两点：x1, y1, x2, y2
about.en: two points on a line: x1, y1, x2, y2

about.zh: 扫地机器人的双目：远墙、没有纹理的地面、障碍物，另给地面以上的区域；期望是区域里的距离，或 1.2 米内要停的地方
about.en: a robot vacuum’s stereo pair, a far wall, a textureless floor and obstacles, with the region above the floor given; the distance in the region, or where to stop within 1.2 m, expected

about.zh: 它占的矩形：x0, y0, x1, y1（不含 x1、y1）
about.en: the rectangle it fills: x0, y0, x1, y1 (x1, y1 excluded)

about.zh: 远墙前面的几层，从后往前
about.en: the layers before the far wall, back to front

about.zh: 同样的房间，已经算好的距离（地面没有纹理，那里的距离是乱的）；期望是 1.2 米内要停的地方
about.en: the same room as distances already found (the floor has no texture, so its distances are anything); where to stop within 1.2 m expected

about.zh: 它占的矩形：x0, y0, x1, y1（不含 x1、y1）
about.en: the rectangle it fills: x0, y0, x1, y1 (x1, y1 excluded)

about.zh: 远墙前面的几层，从后往前
about.en: the layers before the far wall, back to front

about.zh: 地面上乱的距离的种子
about.en: the seed of the floor’s stray distances

about.zh: 一个数进、一个数出：期望是 scale·x + offset
about.en: a number in, a number out: scale·x + offset expected

about.zh: 扫描仪：深色桌面上的一张纸，纸上几行字，可能有噪声，纸可能超出扫描范围
about.en: the scanner: a sheet of paper on a dark desk, a few lines of text, maybe noise, the paper maybe running off the scan

about.zh: 期望：去掉颗粒的扫描件（clean）、Sobel 平方和大于 0.04 处（edges）、纸的边（paper）
about.en: expected: the scan without its grain (clean), where Sobel’s sum of squares is over 0.04 (edges), the paper’s edges (paper)

about.zh: 一行字：x, y, 长度
about.en: a line of text: x, y, length

about.zh: 三类的分数；期望是 softmax 给的三个概率
about.en: the scores of three classes; the three probabilities softmax gives expected

about.zh: 照片 = 油漆 × 光照，光照另给；期望是油漆本来的颜色
about.en: a photo = paint × light, the light given too; the paint itself is expected

about.zh: 彩色照片与已知光照；期望是每个通道的表面反射率
about.en: a colour photograph and known illumination; the surface reflectance in each channel is expected

about.zh: 24 × 24 的货架，小号和大号的记号，可能有颗粒、可能有点糊；期望是小号 X 的中心（small），或连大号 X 也标出（both，大号标成一个 2 × 2 块）
about.en: a 24 × 24 shelf with small and large marks, maybe grainy, maybe a little blurred; the small Xs’ centres (small), or the large ones too, each a 2 × 2 block (both), expected

about.zh: 颗粒的大小
about.en: how strong the grain is

about.zh: 先模糊（高斯的 σ，复制边缘）
about.en: a blur first (the Gaussian’s σ, the edge replicated)

about.zh: 2 是大号
about.en: 2 for a large one

about.zh: 颗粒的种子
about.en: the grain’s seed

about.zh: 噪声 ε 和画哪边 c（0 左，1 右），另给左右两个中心和 σ；期望是那一边 μ + σ·ε 画出的斑点
about.en: noise ε and which side c (0 left, 1 right), with the two centres and σ given; the blob μ + σ·ε draws on that side expected

about.zh: 潜空间里的两个数
about.en: two numbers in latent space

about.zh: 潜空间里的两个数
about.en: two numbers in latent space

about.zh: 潜空间里的两个数
about.en: two numbers in latent space

about.zh: 潜空间里的两个数
about.en: two numbers in latent space

about.zh: 分拣带上的零件：X、O 或 +，位置、墨色、噪点各不同；期望是它属于哪一类
about.en: a part on the sorting belt, an X, an O or a +, at some place, ink and noise; which class it is expected

about.zh: 噪点的种子，0 是没有噪点
about.en: the noise’s seed, 0 for none

about.zh: 一条光谱和三种感光元件的灵敏度曲线；期望是 R、G、B 三个读数
about.en: a spectrum and the sensitivity curves of three sensors; the R, G and B readings are expected

about.zh: 十个波段（400–700 nm，每段 30 nm）的强度
about.en: the strength in ten bands (400–700 nm, 30 nm each)

about.zh: 光谱和感光曲线：将三个传感器读数组成彩色像素
about.en: a spectrum and sensitivity curves: combine the three sensor readings into a colour pixel

about.zh: 十个波段（400–700 nm，每段 30 nm）的强度
about.en: the strength in ten bands (400–700 nm, 30 nm each)

about.zh: 质检台：标准件的照片和传送带上的实物，实物上有凹坑（偏暗）和划痕（偏亮），灯可能老了；期望是缺陷的掩膜
about.en: the inspection station: a photo of the reference and the part on the belt, with dents (darker) and scratches (brighter), under a lamp that may have aged; the defects’ mask is expected

about.zh: 一个矩形：x0, y0, 宽, 高
about.en: a rectangle: x0, y0, width, height

about.zh: 一个矩形：x0, y0, 宽, 高
about.en: a rectangle: x0, y0, width, height

about.zh: 灯还剩原来亮度的几成
about.en: what the lamp has left of its brightness

about.zh: 左右两台相机拍的一对图：远墙前有几层有纹理的东西；期望是视差图
about.en: a pair from a left and a right camera, textured layers before a far wall; the disparity map expected

about.zh: 它占的矩形：x0, y0, x1, y1（不含 x1、y1）
about.en: the rectangle it fills: x0, y0, x1, y1 (x1, y1 excluded)

about.zh: 远墙前面的几层，从后往前
about.en: the layers before the far wall, back to front

about.zh: 街景的三个通道：红灯、阴影里的红车、白色路灯、绿灯；期望是红灯的掩膜
about.en: a street in three channels, with red lights, red cars in shade, white lamps and green lights; the red lights’ mask expected

about.zh: 一个字母化成两个数：斜笔画多少、弯笔画多少；期望 X 是 1，O 是 0
about.en: a letter as two numbers, how much diagonal stroke and how much curved; 1 for an X, 0 for an O expected

about.zh: 一块表面：它的法线和反射率；期望是灯光下的样子（朗伯着色，可以再加一盏半亮的补光）
about.en: a surface, its normals and its reflectance; how it looks under the lamp (Lambert shading, maybe with a half-strength fill light) is expected

about.zh: 鼓包：cx, cy, 半径, 高
about.en: a bump: cx, cy, radius, height

about.zh: 坑：cx, cy, 半径, 深
about.en: a dent: cx, cy, radius, depth

about.zh: 横梁：y0, 半宽, 高
about.en: a ridge: y0, half width, height

about.zh: 斜面：x 方向和 y 方向的坡度
about.en: a slope: its gradient across and down

about.zh: 沟：x0, y0, x1, y1, 半宽, 深
about.en: a groove: x0, y0, x1, y1, half width, depth
a saddle bend: k·((x − 7.5)² − (y − 7.5)²)

about.zh: 高度场：几项相加（每项一个键），空表是平板
about.en: a height field: terms added up (one key each); none is a flat sheet

about.zh: 同一个字母加两次噪声：两张噪声、两个 ᾱ；期望是加完两次的图
about.en: one letter noised twice, two noises and two ᾱ; the picture after both expected

about.zh: 两类各自的排名表和标注数，另给名次；期望是两类 AP 的平均（mAP）
about.en: two classes’ ranked lists and numbers labelled, with the ranks; the mean of their APs (mAP) expected

about.zh: 按分数排好的 16 个检测，对 1 错 0
about.en: the 16 detections in score order, right 1 and wrong 0

about.zh: 按分数排好的 16 个检测，对 1 错 0
about.en: the 16 detections in score order, right 1 and wrong 0

about.zh: 两个斑点和走到哪 t；期望是潜空间里两点之间 t 处的斑点
about.en: two blobs and how far t; the blob at t between them in latent space expected

about.zh: 斑点的中心 (x, y)
about.en: the blob’s centre (x, y)

about.zh: 斑点的中心 (x, y)
about.en: the blob’s centre (x, y)

about.zh: 灰蒙蒙的照片：亮度挤进 0.25 … 0.75，期望是原来的照片
about.en: a washed-out photo, its brightness squeezed into 0.25 … 0.75; the photo as it was is expected

about.zh: 一条 32 个点的波形：平均亮度 c 加几道波；期望是频率 k 那道波的振幅（没有就是 0）
about.en: a waveform of 32 points, an average c plus a few waves; the amplitude of the wave of frequency k (0 if there is none) is expected

about.zh: 错开多少度
about.en: how many degrees it is shifted

about.zh: 暖黄的灯下拍的彩色场景，亮度为 strength；期望是每个通道除以它自己的最大值
about.en: a coloured scene under a warm yellow lamp at brightness strength; each channel divided by its own maximum is expected

about.zh: 暖黄灯下的彩色照片；期望是各通道分别按最大值校正
about.en: a colour photograph under a warm lamp; each channel is corrected by its own maximum

about.zh: 一个 X 或 O，位置、墨色、噪点各不同；期望 X 是 1，O 是 0
about.en: an X or an O at some place, ink and noise; 1 for an X, 0 for an O expected

about.zh: 噪点的种子，0 是没有噪点
about.en: the noise’s seed, 0 for none
